material.acceptance_criteria: Every server stdout line starts with a fixed event name followed by key=value pairs, quoted when a value holds spaces, and one documented grammar covers tick, mod, shed, overrun, relay and reload lines.
material.description: Lines printed by the server mix styles: key=value for tick-time, tick-shed, tick-overrun, mod-tick and client-error; positional for mod-loaded; free text for mod-reload staged and mod-reload FAILED (which embeds a file path and message); and a different prefix reload: in ModHost::reload_if_changed. client-error stdout omits tokens= that the durable log carries (rust/crates/server/src/relay.rs). CI greps each style separately.
material.resolution: One grammar for every server stdout line: ev=<name> then key=value, closed Ev enum of 19 names in log.rs, all 21 emit sites use the helper, the two mod-host reload lines keep {:?} because mod-host cannot depend on the server. CI greps rewritten to the grammar with the same meaning; a grammar check job asserts every sampled line parses.
material.subject: Server stdout lines use several unrelated formats, so a client tool cannot parse them
material.witness_plan: CI job runs oscraftd through one tick, one mod edit, one broken mod edit, one shed and one client error, then checks every stdout line against one regex for the grammar and fails on any unmatched line.
